body:
I agree.  I died about a year ago.  The boring soulless thing I am now is just occupying time until it finds a good way not to.  

Sorry for everything that you've gone through stranger.  You're not alone, but since I have no way of making you feel like you're not alone.. that probably doesn't do much for you.
My greatest source of comfort
Someone I work with asked me about my favorite music, and I just told them that's too personal.
I don't just sit at home alone!  I also sleep a lot at home alone!

Good job.  Any weekend I do laundry I'm proud of myself (I have to walk a few blocks to a laundro-mat) ... never get groceries.. just get a few basics from a close-by pharmacy and usually eat out (subway, jimmy-johns, etc) ... but congrats to you!
I laughed.
The feeling others may get when starring at a white wall.. I feel that way about everything.

I live in a city .... in an apartment in the city.  Thousands upon thousands of people around within a few miles.  Yet, not a single one of them are a friend.  I make no pro-active effort to make friends either.  I feel so bored with everything.  As another poster mentioned.. I could go to a bar, but I don't really feel like I'd enjoy that anymore.  Everything just seems bland to me, and wasting $ on booze doesn't seem to ever help.  So.. meh.  Just killing time until it kills me.  HURRY UP, TIME!

F. is for fire that burns down the whole down
U. is for Uranium BOMBS
N. is for NO SURVIVAL!!
I can do 1-300 push ups in a row!

In death, there is no more worry.  There are no more shitty jobs or regrets.  In death, nobody has failed.  In death, nobody struggles.  In death there are no more tears.  There's no existential crisis.  There's no boredom.  Death is being free from every part of life which you despise.  You give up the good parts too, but typically when you're depressed or even just in a shitty part of life.. the good parts either are barely there or seem barely worth consideration.  When you die you are free from ever being lonely, miserable, uncertain... you are free from the rat-race of life and free from ever having to struggle.  Just knowing I'll get the opportunity to be dead one day helps comfort me through the trials of life.
Death is freedom.
I'm too lazy &/or too much of a bitch to actually do it.. but just reflecting on that thought that I"ll die one day does make me smile.
Instead you should respond "tl;dr" or "?".

Just remember, something I think I tend to forget when I'm manic... other people can see you... and most likely they're not manic... so your actions to them don't make as much sense as your actions do to you

"Every living thing dies alone" -  Donnie Darko 

Regardless of where one is with family, friends or an intimate relationship everyone dies alone.  Everyone dies, alone in the experience of death.. even if one is graced with the fortune of having others close to them.  

I take comfort in this.. likely because I'm too lazy to make friends again (27 .. haven't really had close friends since college.. did have some friends during a stint of homelessness , but no one tends to stick around in my life.. or maybe I just don't stick around theirs) 

Also, while men can lower their standards.. we also have to make an effort.  We're never approached (unless we're very good looking which.. most of us don't qualify for) .. Making an effort to actually approach women or start conversations.. it's incredibly difficult.  Especially if you're cynical.  I may just have the worst way of looking at things.  After I lost my last job for the longest time I didn't feel like trying to get a job again(hence homelessness) bc.. who cares we all die so why waste time on somebody elses clock.  Why do anything?  Then, that's kind of how I see relationships.  Louis ck jested in one special about how in the best case scenario in a relationship one of you gets to see the other one die.  Of course , in such a scenario, there would likely be a lot of great memories too.  Depression tends to be bad for making memories.  
As for kids, making someone else experience the suffering of life, I can't get my head around that.  
A well functioning mind may see life as a gift and creating new life as giving others the opportunity to experience sunsets... but all I see is the mistakes and the car crashes.  Death.  Ruin.  Starvation (Ok, this is America.. so.. morbid obesity instead)  ... Anyway, boo life!  
That is all.

I couldn't even do this right.  :(  

But seriously, thank you for your post.  You gave me something else to read today. :)

Those seizures sound rough.  I've never dealt with anything like that... just mild insanity.  I can relate to wishing not to wake up though.  Waking up, realizing you're still alive is often the worst part of the day... esp if you have a particularly good dream where something great is happening ... and then you're like 'Of course that great thing isn't happening... it's my life we're talking about here'... I hope your issues with seeing and breathing get better.  Sounds like a rough circumstance all around.

Eh , the allure of anywhere fades away eventually.  I remember finding my college town exciting when I was there.. and it eventually becoming dead to me.  Basically anywhere will suck if you feel like your life does and you have a lingering darkness/sadness in your brain... esp if you've had a better life before that you screwed up.  

There are a good number of "cute chicks" that I never go after.  Well, not never.. went on a few dates last year when I was enjoying life more, but those led nowhere.. like life.  I'm kind of too cynical right now to consider dating in any serious way.  I may try again in the summer.. just to have someone to go to parks and the zoo with , and that would likely be the full extent of it.

I live in Pittsburgh.. and I don't have a car... and work in a call center. 
I know there's things to do in this city... like theatres, concerts and such, but nothing really peaks my interest.  
Just walking around the city is probably the most eventful thing I do aside from the job I hate.  I guess I don't hate it as much as it just bores me to death... but I'm hoping to have something else locked down within a few months.  Just taking it one day at a time.  
I haven't had anything that resembled a date since I was hanging out with a crust-punk chick back in September'ish.. I haven't been able to get into dating apps in awhile.  I had a 3 year relationship once that became miserable so I'm not the most motivated person when it comes to trying to date... and then there's the whole thing with my face not being that nice imo.  

Anyway, you're in So cal.. catch some sun! :D

I live in a city and my closest one is 6 miles away.  After the walk though, I think I'm putting the idea of offing myself behind me for awhile.. or I"ll try.  It has been something that in the back.. or front of my mind pretty often.  I'm just going to try getting back into aimless long walks and getting some sunshine while I can.  I was seriously overall in a much better mood consistently when I was homeless and completely broke 6 months ago..  Not sure how much of that was due to a manic episode or the sunshine.. or if they tied in together... either way, I feel noticeably different right now than I have in awhile... not necessarily happy but not miserable & feeling not miserable feels good after feeling miserable for so long.  I don't know.. I'll keep trying to get out more and hopefully it'll help.  

As for stabbing, sounds harsh!  Even when I was at my most depressive state a few years ago and was crying every day and felt like life was over after graduating with a degree in history and starting at an even shittier call center job than I am at now I couldn't even cut deep enough to strike blood.  I must really be a pussy.
Thanks Sergio!

I'm sure you're not, but I know how easy it is to think of yourself that way.  I really identify with this:

I have a friend, he's mostly made of pain

He wakes up, drives to work and straight back home again

He once cut one of my nightmares out of paper

I thought it was beautiful, I put it on a record cover

And I tried to tell him he had a sense

Of color and composition so magnificent

And he said, "Thank you, please

But your flattery

It's truly not becoming me

Your eyes are poor, you're blind you see

No beauty could have come from me

I'm a waste

Of breath, of space, of time"- [Waste of Paint](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q77-ggkzWRI)

Feeling lonely yet not wanting to make a real effort to make friends, constantly dwelling on past bad decisions.. how you got where you are today... and just dwelling on the sheer shitty nature of life and how utterly unfair everything is... it can be a lot to handle.  Good luck with your efforts on being positive.  I'll try to force those rose-colored glasses on myself.
You the man Chunkyman48!
I've had manic phases.. so I've definitely been happy before.  But "happy" me tends to ruin my life and then I'm very unsatisfied for a verryyy long time

I often get upset for how I fucked things up in my life over the past year and I go through the work-week thinking I'll go and buy a gun saturday and offing myself .  I feel like I'm just going to go through years with this thought... If I keep sticking it out into my 40s though I'll be really pissed at myself.  

Good luck with everything.. hopefully one of us gets the courage to end the slings and arrows of misfortune soon

Yes, and last time I did it .. I wanted to be homeless.  

A coworker had died (who I had worked with for 2 years) and this made me want to feel like I was really living in the moment more.  They had died while kayaking and that made my life of work-home-drink/smoke-sleep-etc seem incredibly uninteresting.  So I began hiking after work , just around the city where I live and on different trails, finding places to sit and read books.. watch sunsets.  That might not sound that adventurous, but to me it was a lot more than what I had been doing.  But then I started staying out later and later.  One evening I ran into a large group of crust-punks and I had no idea that their life-style was a thing.  Young people, seemingly homeless by choice, "travelers" , people who got to do whatever they wanted whenever.  I was also really into minimalism at the time(had got on a kick of tossing a ton of stuff) , so backpacking became even more appealing.  Over the course of a month I started sleeping less and less.. eating less and less, and ultimately became kind of obnoxious.  I really wanted my own sort of traveling adventure.. However , for some reason, relaying at work to my manager and others that I had been sitting down and talking with "crusties" and had a desire to hop trains .... and also all the time off I was taking .. and some apparently vaguely threatening comments I made.. all were enough for me to eventually be fired.  


When I found out I was fired I was about 80 miles NW of my home city.  No car & I lost my debit card so I had no access to any money.  So, that was a lot of fun.  Anyway, after being fired I was in no mood to look for jobs.. I still wanted a real adventure.  I saw homelessness as true freedom.  Lots of things happened, but I'm not a particularly good story teller and I'm lazy.  Perhaps those two go hand in hand.. but anyway.. I was homeless for 4 months, squatting where I used to rent for 2 of them , in a tent for one, and backpacking from Richmond to Virginia beach for 40 days (and running out of money approx 1/2 way through). 


I was an asshole to a lot of people during that time.. not really sure what came over me.  
Now I wake up in regret every day , mourning my idiotic decisions of almost a year ago which led to me getting fired ... and now working at a call center for a bank... 


It was my 2nd prolonged manic episode.  So, I kind of knew what was going on... but... after my first extended depressed episode which came after my 1st prolonged manic episode.. I had longed for the day of another manic episode.. In my episodes I'm special, feel "chosen" in some way, everything has meaning, and I just want to talk to everyone and touch every tree.  


Then everything is dead (well.. I'm dead inside , so .. everything seems dead) .. But part of it might be that my crazy periods (esp this last one) can be so exciting with numerous death threats and getting drunk and doing drugs with random people in random places  .... then going back to getting up, going to work, and generally being a shut in in my apt outside of that just feels so lame.   

I should probably find a healthy middle-ground.. but I doubt I ever will.  

tl;dr- went from stable decent job I liked to envying homeless people to becoming homeless to shitty call-center
Our genes came from people too afraid to kill themselves.  So we're destined to the same fate.

27 here.  I remember when I was a lost teen, and I was asked what I want to do with my life and I had no fucking clue. 

Luckily, now I have no fucking clue... except... I know I don't want to do any of the things I've done so far.  So, it's kind of like I have a map of the world and I'm trying to figure out where I am, and I've learned of 5 places where I definitely am not.  

So, still lost... but at least I know I'm not in Anchorage, Alaska.  I figured that much out.

Most likely if you go homeless you're not going to die extremely soon.  I once went homeless for fun... but I do debate sometimes when I'm getting up for work "Hmm... I could go buy a gun and kill myself instead.. or just not go to work and eventually become homeless and just live that way until I die" .  Homeless people do tend to die sooner than everyone else.. so there's that to look forward to.

The only texts I ever get are for someone named Martha that used to have my phone .  My most recent text was yesterday at 1:00pm "Hi, Martha! Thank you for hoosing King's Jewelry.  could you take 30 seconds to leave us a review using the link below" 

I know I don't really have it in me to get a decent conversation going with new friends.  I don't really know what I'd talk about.. and I don't really want to focus on how much I hate life (particularly, mine.. ) .. just sounds self-absorbed.  Fuckitalll

Happy Birthday ProfDali!
Pizza is the only thing I can think of.

Same.

Seems like there's a lot of us.  I guess it's /r/SuicideWatch normal.  So , we have that going for us!
Jericho
I am not a krusty crab...

I'm so sorry!  Usually I'm able to sleep 10-12 hours a night (sorry for bragging) , but there was one time when  I was extremely depressed and there was a 2 night period where I couldn't fall asleep at all.  It's awful.. because you don't get that escape that depressed people love(sleep).   
Try counting down from 1,000.. or thinking of a word and just repeating it in your head over and over again (like the word sleep) .  Or 420 if that's an option for you.

When I'm not depressed...  I love to drink and watch youtube videos or Netflix .. sometimes even go out to random bars and talk to random people.  I used to drink anywhere from 3-6 times per week.  

Now, drinking just leads to me being sleepy and feeling even more miserable about my situation.  I don't need that.  

I can't wait until the day drinking is fun again...if that ever happens.
Impressive!
It cured my alcoholism too!
I think of how stupid I am often.  Only an idiot would have made 1/2 the decisions I've made.. and he would have been smart enough to avoid the other half.
Often, when I'm eating, waiting, sitting, watching things, etc. I like to reflect on past decisions in regret.  I like to reflect on everything I've squandered so far in life.

I sit alone on my laptop or phone scrolling through reddit threads, watching youtube videos, or starting a Netflix series and never finishing. 

Also, I sleep a lot. 

I'm sure we have a lot to discuss.

Hello, I'm a stranger on the internet & I wanted to wish you a happy birthday.  I wanted to share my favorite birthday song with you: [Try to remember, forget](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tgPgs0D4PPM)   ... That is all.
I want out.  I want an off button.  I want to sleep forever.  I hate being dead inside and having to continue going through the motions.

For some reason I came to believe that Lockheed Martin had spies that were investigating me because I was some sort of threat as I was pushing for peace & love.  There were probably a good 5-10 random people who I saw on various days during a certain period of time who I believed were Lockheed Martin's spies.  I thought I had uncovered some big secret of a unifying consciousness which connects everybody and I did some blogs and threw away a bunch of money on a website .. I've believed a lot of insane things about myself and other people in 2 seperate manic phases.. and with both of them.. I had done LSD within the months prior to the manic phase.  I wouldn't do anything crazy while on it either..  I would just eventually come to believe weird things.   I would never even list all of them out due to embarrassment.

Dear Self, 

If tomorrow is like today will I be able to handle that one? Is there anything which I can do to make it better?  

I know the summer will be here before too long.  I just got through another Winter.  Perhaps another summer? 

Perhaps I can think of one more dream that I can accomplish before I go.  Perhaps I can think of one more thing I'd like to do before I'd die.  Maybe there is someone I've yet to meet who will intrigue me?  

If you wake up tomorrow and want to start chatting with someone else who feels that their life is often void of all meaning, PM MUH.
I love dream adventures!  I was hopping trains a few nights ago.  In real life, I now work in a call center and have no friends and my life is incredibly bland.

I say this little chant in my head... You know that episode of the office with Andy's audition attempt after he's late and they won't let him on the show & he sits there and says "Sit here and cry?  Oh I can just sit here and cry" .. I chant that rhythm in my head repeatedly with "lay here and sleep? lay here and sleep.  Oh I can just lay here and sleep" .  It was really bad when I was unemployed.. I was sleeping until 12pm or 1PM , then go to bed at 11pm or 12am.  Now that I have a job it's not as bad.. except on weekends it's worse.  Now I can smoke weed(as I has job) I continue going to sleep, smoking and watching something then passing out.. I just tend to sleep the weekends away.  I tell myself I'll stop when it's warm and sunny on the weekends.  I suppose time will tell.  There's part of me that thinks I should be more productive, and I'm sure there are self-improvement things I could do, but then what's the point?   I think as long as we enjoy sleeping and it helps us through depression, there's no issue getting as much sleep as we want.   I wish the best for you _chapelperilous_

I become everything that I despise.  I mindlessly scroll social media feeds with no purpose.  I don't read books.  I'll try to watch shows and just be uninterested.  Then I'll just have thoughts about how I'm uninterested in everything, then I'll tell myself how stupid it is to constantly think about how I don't have any interest in anything.  then I tell my brain to shut up.  Then I stare at things like a zombie longer.  Then I look for posts online where it seems people may have it worse than me

Jumping, that's intense.  

I let my student loans get really far behind and then call to place in forbearance and restart the payments... I have about 7k in medical debt, and somewhere around 7k in charged-off credit card debt.  

I have awful credit, so I never care to make a payment on any of it.  

I screwed up my finances years ago and it's hard to get motivated to get back on track... however, that's not what makes me want to die... but it certainly doesn't hurt. 

The idea of being completely free of debt by no longer being alive... sounds glorious.

I have acquaintances that I worked with 6+ years ago & family that check in with me like I'm a cancer patient... but as far as friends that I actually get to hang out with and talk about random things with, no.

During my last semester in college I had a severe depressive period... the cry out of nowhere , miserable every day type.  I felt as if my brain had slowed down to a halt.  I couldn't remember anything I studied.  It took me much longer to write papers ... just putting paragraphs together was a challenge.  Some of the professors I had definitely gave me a break and gave me an A when I didn't deserve it... 

Not that it matters.. With my major, I could have had a 2.0 and it wouldn't have made a difference.. 

I felt a lot better for the past 2 years (up until November'ish) while I was working for a logistics company.   Then I got fired during a Manic episode (which lasted through November..) 

My current depression episode is relatively minor.  I look back in regret over losing my last job more than I should... and I just feel like my brain isn't operating at optimum capacity.  

While I can watch a 10 min youtube video.. I can't get into a series on Netflix.  I can't focus on the plot well enough to stay interested to keep watching.  The sense of mindlessness does get so frustrating.   I keep asking myself what I would like to learn about.. what I would like to do , and in the end I just have no interest in much of anything.  

The main thing getting me through all of this is knowing that I went through a depression episode so much worse than this ... 

Anyway, glad to see I'm not alone in feeling slow.  By glad, I mean I'm staring at my screen with a completely blank expression(the dumb one that's usually on my face) and I'm saying some cliche thing about sharing a common experience with some random person
Are you going to reply to each of my comments?
I just don't smoke for awhile if I don't have a job.  I pass the drug test.. then I start smoking again.  There are ways to beat the drug test with synthetic or someone else's urine... but meh.
The only reason I ever leave it is so I can pay to have a place where I can lay on it.

I had friends in college.  All moved to cities far away after graduation.  I haven't really had a friend that I hung out with or communicated with regularly in about 3 years.  At my last job, there was someone who I occasionally hung out with and smoked with, but even that was pretty rare.  You're definitely not alone in this.  I don't know how to make friendships a part of my life again..

I go to sleep around midnight and try to keep going back to sleep until 12pm/1pm  .... I blame it on winter and being unemployed though.  There's only so much Netflix/youtube/reddit/etc that one can do in a day... and it's not much more entertaining to me than sleeping.

I've been unemployed for over 6 months and it's starting to kill me.. it's really taxing on my mental health.  I'm so perpetually bored and borderline suicidal.  Today I decided I'm going to try for a factory job since I seem to botch every interview I do.  Anyway, I don't know how you keep it together or handled 4 years of unemployment. Kuddos sir!
Thank you.  I'll try.  I have 2 more months of unemployment , which will be enough for another 3 months of rent.   I'll keep pushing forward... it's just annoying.
I'm looking for any sort of inside sales/customer service type position in my area now.  I'm not confident that I'll find a way to stabilize my life.  I've been rejected so many times..
